arrangement.notes: Focus on vocal-driven aggression with hook-heavy energy spikes, emphasizing sample chopping techniques in the production layers.

event_markers.label: Main Hook Start
event_markers.reason: Beginning of the hook section with maximum energy and vocal focus

event_markers.label: Final Hook Start
event_markers.reason: Return of the hook with highest energy for the song climax

sound_intent.focus: vocal aggression with hook-dense dynamic shifts, employing sample chopping techniques named as production channels
sound_intent.timbre: dark, gritty, textured with layered chopped vocal samples and rhythmic complexity

routing_intent.vocal: processed through granular and stutter channels for sharp rhythmic phrasing
routing_intent.drums: routed with glitch and roll channels for dynamic percussive variation
routing_intent.bass: glide and chop channels for smooth yet aggressive movement
routing_intent.chords: slice and reverse channels to add atmospheric tension
routing_intent.fx: glitch and granular for transitions and space creation

track_roles.drums: rhythmic foundation using glitch and roll chops
track_roles.bass: harmonic drive with glide and chop layers
track_roles.melody: subtle lead elements, minimal to support vocals
track_roles.vocal: primary melodic and emotional focus with sliced and stuttered processing

designer_intent.goal: Create a Trip Hop arrangement emphasizing aggressive, hook-heavy vocal variations, exploiting advanced sample chop techniques for production channels.

presetor_intent.instructions: Configure presets oriented around stuttered, sliced vocal chops with textured glitch and granular effects for dynamic rhythmic and harmonic interest.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate drum patterns emphasizing rhythmic complexity and incorporating glitch and roll sample chop techniques.

bass_generator.brief: Create bass lines with glide and chop sample channel effects to enhance groove and aggressiveness.

harmony_generator.brief: Provide chordal textures using slice and reverse sample chopping for atmospheric tension.

melody_generator.brief: Add minimal melodic elements to complement vocal lines without overpowering them.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement structure ensuring vocal focus with hook-intensive energy peaks and smooth section transitions.

presetor.brief: Apply and tweak presets tailored for sample chopping effects on vocals, drums, and FX channels.

songgps.brief: Manage overall energy curve and section dynamics maintaining hook prominence and vocal aggression.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare unprocessed channel audio mixes prioritizing clarity and separation of chopped sample layers.
